formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x1 → x1.size ≤ (124 : ℕ) → (∀ (x4 : Fin (42 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x4) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x5 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) (x6 : Fin (42 : ℕ)), (↑x5 < (21 : ℕ) ∧ (21 : ℕ) ≤ ↑x6 ∧ (↑x6 + (21 : ℕ) - ↑x5) % (21 : ℕ) ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ), (17 : ℕ), (20 : ℕ)]) ∧ x4 x5 = Bool.true ∧ x4 x6 = Bool.true) → ∃ (x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x5 ∧ x5.size ≤ (124 : ℕ) ∧ (∀ (x6 : Fin (42 : ℕ) → Bool), x5.eval (List.ofFn x6) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x7 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) (x8 : Fin (42 : ℕ)), (↑x7 < (21 : ℕ) ∧ (21 : ℕ) ≤ ↑x8 ∧ (↑x8 + (21 : ℕ) - ↑x7) % (21 : ℕ) ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ), (17 : ℕ), (20 : ℕ)]) ∧ x6 x7 = Bool.true ∧ x6 x8 = Bool.true) ∧ ∃ (x6 : ℕ) (x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x5.gates[x6]? = Option.some x7 ∧ x7.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ (x5.wires (List.ofFn fun (x8 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (↑x8 ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (1 : ℕ), (2 : ℕ), (6 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ), (18 : ℕ), (24 : ℕ), (31 : ℕ), (33 : ℕ), (37 : ℕ)]))).getD ((42 : ℕ) + x6) Bool.false = Bool.true
plain_statement: Plane of order 4 (points 0..20, lines 21..41, point p on line 21 + l when p - l mod 21 is 0, 1, 4, 14 or 16), F its incidence function, W the input with points 0, 1, 2, 6, 8, 18 and lines 24, 31, 33, 37 on (no incident pair). If some fan-in-two AND/OR circuit with at most 124 gates computes F, then some such circuit computing F has an AND gate true at W.
title: A step toward: No circuit of fan-in-two AND/OR gates with at most 124 gates computes the incidence function of the projective plane of order 4
